mapper.select: select id, portal_id as portalId, res_id as resId, res_type as resType, inherit_enabled as inheritEnabled from ssm_portal_resource_auth_inherit where res_id = #{resId} and res_type = #{resType} limit 1
select res_id as resId, res_type as resType, inherit_enabled as inheritEnabled from ssm_portal_resource_auth_inherit where portal_id = #{portalId}
select res_id from ssm_portal_resource_auth_inherit where portal_id = #{portalId} and inherit_enabled = 0
mapper.insert: insert into ssm_portal_resource_auth_inherit (portal_id, res_id, res_type, inherit_enabled, created_by, created_time, updated_by, updated_time) values (#{portalId}, #{resId}, #{resType}, #{inheritEnabled}, #{createdBy}, now(), #{updatedBy}, now()) on duplicate key update portal_id = values(portal_id), inherit_enabled = values(inherit_enabled), updated_by = values(updated_by), updated_time = values(updated_time)
